title: A deep learning-informed interpretation of why and when dose metrics outside the PTV can affect the risk of distant metastasis in SBRT NSCLC patients
summary: A deep model and explainable analysis identified dose and tumor features associated with distant metastasis in a 478-patient stereotactic-body-radiotherapy cohort; this is a retrospective association, not causal evidence.
ai_technology: Deep-learning metastasis-risk model with explainable feature analysis
organization: Faculty of Nuclear Sciences and Physical Engineering, Czech Technical University in Prague, Prague, Czechia

evidence.tested: A deep model and explainable analysis identified dose and tumor features associated with distant metastasis in a 478-patient stereotactic-body-radiotherapy cohort; this is a retrospective association, not causal evidence.
evidence.unknown: The reported association does not establish causation; transfer beyond the stated cohorts and any practical benefit were not established.
